issue.title: Add drag-to-clear with page-turn, clear sound and haptics to native
issue.body:
**What:** Clear is a plain tap inside the tools dialog. Port drag-to-clear: accept ring, torn-edge preview, page-turn animation, clear sound, haptics, and the Clear coachmark that teaches it.

**Where:** Svelte `ClearButton.svelte`, `ClearRing.svelte`, `ClearCoachmark.svelte`, `actions/dragToClear.ts`, `audio/clearSound.ts`, `platform/haptics.ts`.

**Done when:** a child can drag the Clear button to clear the page with the animation, sound and haptic, and the coachmark shows on first use.

Part of #2690.
issue.display_title: Add drag-to-clear with page-turn, clear sound and haptics to native

comments.body: Done in #2780 (merged into `codex/native-migration`): drag-to-clear on the edge Clear button with the shipping thresholds, accept ring, page turn, clear sound, haptics and the wordless coachmark; Auto-Save on Delete runs before a drag-clear.
